Subject: Security exhibit + SOC 2 evidence and pen-test window

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — Brightpoint's product team is excited about Redwood. Legal asked me to gather the security exhibit details so we can sign the MSA + order form. A few asks from our side up front:

- Can you confirm Redwood's latest SOC 2 type II report and whether you will allow us to keep a copy on record?
- We need explicit pen-test language in the exhibit (allowed windows, notification, point-of-contact for coordination).
- Order form needs to include audit-rights language and a proposed evidence cadence for ongoing compliance checks.

I've attached our security questionnaire (v3) and a short procurement checklist. We'd like to lock the order form and target a pen-test window in mid-May if possible.

Can you route this to your legal and compliance owners and propose next steps? Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week if that helps.

Thanks,
Sam Ellis
Security Lead — Brightpoint Labs
security@brightpointlabs.com

Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 evidence and pen-test window

Sam — thanks for the clear list and for sharing the questionnaire. Looping in our legal lead (Laura) and our Assurance ops lead (Jordan) to own redlines and scheduling. Quick responses while legal reviews:

- SOC 2: we will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. We typically retain a copy for 12 months on a customer request; Laura, please confirm if we can grant Brightpoint longer retention.
- Pen-test language: we are open to a defined window (+ 48–72h pre-notice) and a staging environment for the test. We'll need to align on SLAs for exploit reporting and remediation timelines.
- Audit rights & cadence: we propose a quarterly evidence snapshot (rolling 12-month) plus an annual deeper review. Jordan — can you draft a suggested evidence cadence grid (who owns what artifact and cadence)?

Next steps: Laura, please review the attached order form draft (I'm attaching our initial redlines) and call out any MSA changes required. Sam — are you available Tuesday 23rd, 10:00–10:30 PT for a sync? If not, propose alternatives.

Proposed attachments: Redlined_OrderForm_Redwood_v1.docx, PenTest_Window_Proposal.xlsx

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Assurance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@brightpointlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 evidence and pen-test window — legal redline summary

Team / Sam — I reviewed Brightpoint's questionnaire and the redlined order form. High-level legal asks and proposed language:

1) SOC 2 report access and retention
- We can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II under NDA. We propose an explicit clause: "Customer may retain a copy of Vendor SOC 2 Type II report for a period of twelve (12) months from delivery unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing." If Brightpoint needs multi-year retention, we'll need a scoped exception in the MSA.

2) Audit rights and inspection scope
- We can agree to "reasonable audit rights" limited to the service components used by Brightpoint with 30 days' notice, performed during normal business hours. We will refuse audits that seek access to vendor proprietary tools, internal developer code, or multi-tenant telemetry beyond customer-specific artifacts.
- Suggest adding a requirement for pre-approved scope and a mutually agreed statement of work for any onsite or privileged inspection.

3) Penetration testing language
- Acceptable: customer may perform penetration testing against a designated staging environment during a mutually agreed window. Tests must be non-destructive; any production-impacting tests are prohibited.
- Require a 72-hour pre-notice. Post-test: customer must provide a responsible disclosure report; vendor will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide remediation ETA within five (5) business days for high-severity findings.

4) Evidence cadence / artifact list (operational)
- I don't want fine-grained ops artifacts in the MSA; instead, we can add an exhibit that lists the artifacts and cadence (SOC report delivery, annual attestation, quarterly control snapshots, incident logs on request subject to redaction rules). Jordan: please draft an operational exhibit that maps artifacts to owners and delivery cadence.

5) Liability / indemnity carveouts
- If Brightpoint requires broader audit rights, we need commensurate liability limits tied to the Order Form value. Any carveouts should be escalated to commercial.

Sam — if these are agreeable in principle, Laura recommends a short triage call to confirm the pen-test window specifics and whether Brightpoint needs extended SOC retention.

I'll open a tracked redline against the MSA + Order Form and share a DocuSign-ready copy once we align.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: summary-redlines-msa-orderform.txt

Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 evidence & pen-test scheduling — next steps

Sam — thanks and appreciate the quick turnaround Laura. To summarize and propose a concrete plan:

Action items
- Laura to circulate tracked redlines against MSA + Order Form (legal) — target: Wed 24 Mar EOD.
- Jordan to publish an operational exhibit mapping artifacts to cadence (quarterly snapshot + annual attestation) and owners — target: Thu 25 Mar.
- Soojin to share SOC 2 Type II under NDA and confirm staging environment readiness for pen test window.
- Sam/Procurement to confirm whether Brightpoint requires SOC retention beyond 12 months (yes/no).

Pen-test window
- Proposed window: 10–24 May 2027 (staging only). Require 72-hour pre-notice and a designated point-of-contact in production if any scoped tests could touch prod-like telemetry. Please flag any blackout dates. Jordan and I will support test coordination and review responsible disclosure templates.

Call to align
- Let's do the 30-minute sync: Tue 23 Mar, 10:00–10:30 PT. Agenda: SOC retention ask, confirm pen-test window & staging environment details, review high-level redlines that would impact commercial.

Attachments referenced: Redlined_OrderForm_Redwood_v1.docx, PenTest_Window_Proposal.xlsx 

If that schedule works I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (redlines + evidence cadence grid).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Assurance Programs
